competence_field.composition_rule: Let every pertinent owner-native competence participate; no mandatory primary or fixed support count is imposed.

evidence: situated context and the actual useful result
an experiment when a hypothesis or comparative claim calls for it
preserved knowledge and observed reentry when making a continuity claim
completion.success_condition: The project can use its Kernel from the real context, produce a useful result and resume from preserved knowledge and state.

environment_readiness.credential_boundary: Explain and request access when needed; never embed credentials in the package.

requirements.relation: A capable coder or agentic harness can read project instructions and act on files.
The coder has usable model access through a provider, API or local model.
Python 3.10 or later can run installation and deterministic helpers.
Git and a repository service such as GitHub preserve collaboration and recovery when useful.
A VPS or project-specific stack is prepared only when the selected work needs it.

environment_readiness.rule: Observe what the current coder, model access and target already provide. Begin directly when the field is sufficient; explain and establish only a material missing condition for the selected project.

role.purpose: Orient, configure and operate one project through its sources, pertinent competences, resultants, causal learning and reentry.
